flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: All in ocmseserviceui: pages/Furnish/Summary.ts (furnish-summary component), pages/Furnish/Confirmation.ts (Review step), pages/Furnish/Furnish.ts (stepper and onUpdate). No code in the other repos.
note: Requirement is given and status is Fully paid. Step 3 'Review' shows the selected notices, owner/company particulars, full hirer/driver particulars, verification-question answers and the list of attached documents, all read-only. The declaration checkbox and Submit button are on the same page but belong to another story (OCMS42.26) and are not counted here. No gap found in the summary display; the real browser rendering was not tested (code only).
recommendation: Claimable in full for the summary display. The declaration checkbox and Submit belong to another story.

steps.step: After the details are saved, the page opens the Review step that lists the selected notices
steps.detail: The stepper has three steps: Notice Details, Furnish Particulars, Review (Furnish.ts:517-532). Once validation passes, Particulars calls stepper.show(3) (Particulars.ts:149). Confirmation renders the selected-notices table and then <furnish-summary> (Confirmation.ts:243-245).

steps.step: The summary shows the owner or company particulars already filled in
steps.detail: For a company, InitComParticulars shows Company Name, Representative's Name, Mobile Number, Email (Summary.ts:81-110); for an individual, InitOParticulars shows Full Name, Mobile Number, Email (Summary.ts:112-149). The component is chosen by isCP (Summary.ts:298-308).

steps.step: The summary shows the hirer/driver particulars keyed in: name, ID, address, contact, email, relationship
steps.detail: InitHDParticulars shows Full Name, ID with its type, Postal Code, Block/House Number, Street Name, Floor & Unit, Building Name, Mobile Number, Email Address, Relationship to owner, Other Relationship when present, and rental start/end date-time when relationship = Vehicle is leased (Summary.ts:151-231). The data is read from formData, so it equals what was keyed in.

steps.step: The summary shows the verification-question answers and the list of supporting documents attached
steps.detail: HDQuests shows the Q1/Q1Yes/Q1No answers, hidden for ID type UEN (Summary.ts:233-271). The document table shows the file name and size per category (Summary.ts:273-293, 312-316). Furnish.onUpdate refreshes the summary from the latest formData every time Proceed to review is pressed (Furnish.ts:158-168).
